finding.detail: Dataset admission required an outcome receipt to be present in the admitted outcome registry for UNKNOWN-credit traces, but skipped the exact causal outcome binding check unless credit was non-UNKNOWN. An admitted receipt from a different Entry/route/GRID10 episode could therefore be attached to an UNKNOWN training row as false provenance without minting reward.

repair.mechanism: Whenever outcome_receipt_sha256 is present, require admitted receipt status/credit/training trace/transition trace/generation/Entry event/Entry admission/route/GRID10/cell/role binding, including credit_label=UNKNOWN.

regression.case: UNKNOWN row + admitted but unrelated outcome receipt must fail OUTCOME_CAUSAL_BINDING_MISMATCH; exactly-bound UNKNOWN receipt remains admissible.
